accuracy_notes: Listed-building point records were not treated as listing extents.
Listed-building outline service was retained as incomplete/indicative and not used as a curtilage or title boundary.
Conservation-area incompleteness and duplicate warnings were preserved.
Listed Building Consent, Scheduled Monument Consent and planning permission were kept as distinct decision regimes.
No heritage designation was converted into an automatic refusal or Future Growth score.
